late|grammatische Form|1.definition: A grammatical determination that an analyst can recover or render in a language despite the lack of its own special designation. The claim does not decide whether strict grammatical form is present in the language itself.
late|grammatische Form|1.rule: Describe recoverability in§133 without equating it with overt linguistic marking. Compare the later strict audible criterion in§147 and the speaker/language distinction of§142.
late|grammatische Form|1.caution: Shared thought-relations, analyst labels and a language’s own means remain different questions.

late|Satz|1.caution: Use proposition only where a logical-judgement use is explicitly at issue, such as the separately recorded assertion use;§136 itself supplies no modern truth-condition definition. Preserve the contrast with Periode, and do not infer a new sense from printed448’s unresolved same-Satz phrase.

late|Periode|1.definition: The grammatical whole in which thought-form and language-form unite: unity of thought-relations is joined by linguistic embodiment, the regulated resources of the language, and conditions of intelligibility and utterance.
late|Periode|1.rule: Retain period or an explained sentence-period as distinct from Satz. The contrast concerns the whole’s principle of unity, not merely sentence length.
late|Periode|1.caution: This is the local§136 distinction, not a fixed equation with modern clause/sentence terminology.

late|Symbol|1.label: symbolic embodiment in linguistic expression
late|Symbol|1.definition: The symbol or sensible embodiment in which language casts thought, analytically distinguished from thought’s essence within a discussion that also insists on the synthetic unity of the two forms.
late|Symbol|1.rule: Retain symbol as the source word here, with its local thought/embodiment contrast. Do not treat the symbol as an arbitrary detachable label.
late|Symbol|1.caution: This is a contextual/metaphorical use, not proof that every Symbol occurrence has the strict natural-form definition of§101. In§136 the analytically distinguished forms are inseparable in actual language.

late|Zeichen|1.label: empty sign contrasted with designated content
late|Zeichen|1.definition: A sign contrasted with substituting what is designated for it; the immediately parallel phrase contrasts putting a concept in place of form.
late|Zeichen|1.rule: Preserve both parallels in§141. The formal reading is supported by this local opposition, not by importing§147’s strict criterion into the fragment.
late|Zeichen|1.caution: Empty is the source’s description in this polemic, not a claim that speakers cannot understand or that all signs lack contribution.

middle|Vermögen|1.rule: Use faculties for the cooperating mental powers in§90 (p421), and capacity for a language’s ability to meet expressive need in§110 (p434). A capacity is not one actual act or its resulting content.
middle|Vermögen|1.caution: The bearers and English renderings are conditional; this does not establish a strict universal Kraft/Vermögen taxonomy.

early|Form|3.definition: Connection in discourse as form relative to words as matter; this division is explicitly not the sounds/rules division.

early|Verstand|1.rule: Use understanding/intellect for the analytical faculty. Use sense only when the construction concerns meaning or an interpretation, as in im strengsten Verstände; not every prepositional im Verstande phrase is idiomatic.

late|Verstand|1.rule: Use understanding for this faculty. The possessed construction im Verstande des Redenden also names the speaker’s understanding, not the sense of an expression.
late|Verstand|1.caution: A preposition alone does not decide the meaning; distinguish the separate meaning/interpretation idiom by syntax and context.

form-mode-activity.label: form or mode of formative activity
form-mode-activity.definition: Form used for the mode or organization of mental/linguistic activity, including determinate thought and its externalization. The explicit law/direction/procedure stipulation belongs to§136.
form-mode-activity.rule: Identify the operation and bearer in the local use. Keep§136’s stipulation visible without retroactively making it the exhaustive definition of every earlier Form.
form-mode-activity.caution: These are grouped contextual uses of a broad form vocabulary, not a single unchanging technical doctrine. The individual source uses and their conditions remain below.

form-configuration.label: word or sound configuration considered as a pattern
form-configuration.definition: A formed word/sound configuration, considered as a persistent or general pattern relative to changing content and individual actualization.
form-configuration.rule: Use form for the cited pattern; distinguish it from current word-content and from a form/matter analysis of the faculties.
form-configuration.caution: The printed word-formation and general-word contexts remain distinct uses; neither licenses phoneme or morpheme as an automatic replacement.

form-grammatical.label: grammatical or purely formal determination
form-grammatical.definition: Form used for grammatical means or formal determination, with the local contrast between a device and its effect or between formal indication and unnecessary substantive content.
form-grammatical.rule: Preserve the particular formal/material or means/effect contrast; do not identify all such uses with one later strict criterion for genuine grammatical form.
form-grammatical.caution: This is a working grouping of related uses. The source’s rankings and causal claims remain attributed, not endorsed.

form-relative-matter.label: form relative to the matter or material of a particular analysis
form-relative-matter.definition: The organizing or active side of a locally specified form/matter relation: discourse-connection versus words, the word’s coordinating contribution, or thought’s operations versus objects.
form-relative-matter.rule: State what counts as matter and form in each source use. In§55 words/discourse-connection is expressly not sounds/rules; the word and thought discussions have different bearers.
form-relative-matter.caution: These contextual uses must not be flattened into syntax, sound shape, or one independent metaphysical substance.

verstand-faculty.label: faculty of understanding
verstand-faculty.definition: Understanding as an intellectual faculty engaged in analysis, distinctions and thought, locally contrasted with other faculties such as creative imagination or synthesizing reason.
verstand-faculty.rule: Prefer understanding where faculty contrasts matter. In im Verstande des Redenden the possessor identifies the speaker’s faculty; it is not the idiom in the sense.
verstand-faculty.caution: Different activities of this faculty are retained as contextual uses, not counted as new lexical senses. The separate sense-of-expression idiom requires its own construction and context.

weltansicht-view.label: view or standpoint of the world
weltansicht-view.definition: A view/standpoint of the world belonging to an individual and further shaped and intensified through language; a language’s connected presentation can thus have its own distinctive world-view.
weltansicht-view.rule: Preserve the individual standpoint already possible independently of language in§39 and the additional contribution made by language. Keep individual and language bearers explicit.
weltansicht-view.caution: The uses do not imply identical beliefs or one ideology for all speakers. The later Weltansicht/Weltanschauung interpretive distinction is a control, not an invariant lexical law proved here.

sprachform-language-form.label: form of a language and its expression
sprachform-language-form.definition: Language’s form(s), considered as shared patterns admitting individual use and, in§136, as specifically linguistic organization distinct in analysis from thought-form.
sprachform-language-form.rule: In§50 preserve general forms and individualized use; in§136 preserve the extra linguistic conditions directed toward the Periode. Use the local bearer rather than counting plurality alone as a new lexical sense.
sprachform-language-form.caution: Do not insert inner where the source does not say it, or reduce Sprachform to morphology. The local thought/language distinction does not make two separable substances.

verstand-idiom.label: sense or interpretation in a qualifying idiom
verstand-idiom.definition: The meaning or interpretation in which something is taken, as in the strictest or proper sense, rather than the intellectual faculty of a person.
verstand-idiom.rule: Use sense for the cited qualifying idioms im strengsten/eigentlichen Verstände. A possessed phrase such as im Verstande des Redenden refers instead to the speaker’s understanding.
verstand-idiom.caution: The preposition im alone is not a diagnostic. Syntax, possessor and the surrounding argument decide the local use.

relations.reason: Both local compounds concern thought-form contrasted with Sprachform; no separate doctrine is inferred from the lexical difference.
§1 distinguishes native interaction/dealings and contact; neither term alone certifies a particular mechanism of language mixture.
Linguistic stock and human grouping are different bearers in the opening; continental grouping is not a certified modern language family.

§§144–147 separate concept designation/substantive conceptual content from a relation indicated as relation; neither is simply an English meaning/denotation split.

Weltansicht|Weltvorstellung.reason: Different observed formulations kept searchable; no invariant semantic opposition is inferred merely from different nouns.

Stamm|Wurzel.reason: Stamm has human-group and lexical-base uses; Wurzel belongs to word-formation analysis. Compare only the relevant local use rather than positing one universal opposition.

Wort|Laut.reason: Sound is the word’s sensible contribution in§72; the word is treated as a unity, not as an independently complete sound plus an independently finished concept.

Grammatik|allgemeine Grammatik.reason: The modifier specifies a general-grammar inquiry in the cited contexts; it does not identify every use of Grammatik with modern universal grammar.

Phantasie|Zuverlässigkeit.reason: Imaginative historical/etymological discovery does not by itself establish secure evidence; these are not two psychological faculties in a taxonomy.
